name: Multiunit auction
summary: Sealed-bid auction where multiple identical units are sold to several bidders at once.
rules_text: There are k identical items for sale. Each bidder has a private valuation for units. Simultaneously each player submits one or more bids, each bid stating a quantity desired and a price per unit they are willing to pay. Bids are sealed. After all bids are collected, bids are ranked by price descending. Items are allocated in that order until exhausted, giving each winner up to their requested quantity at that bid. In a uniform-price version all winners pay the same per-unit price equal to the lowest winning bid, or alternatively the highest losing bid. In a discriminatory pay-as-bid version each winner pays their own bid prices.
rating_reason: Specific auction type with multiple homogeneous items and bidding
